name: APIVerveSpellChecker
summary: Spell Checker flags misspelled words in submitted English text and generates correction suggestions.
description:
Spell Checker flags misspelled words in submitted English text and generates correction suggestions. It counts total spelling errors and lists possible replacements for each mistaken word.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Spell Checker from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
